title: Stuck in Place: Stall Diagnosis and Remedies for JEPA Planners
title_zh: 原地卡住：JEPA 规划器的停滞诊断与补救
abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models plan from pixels with model predictive control, yet often fail on tasks their model should handle. Test-time adaptation attributes such failures to model error under distribution shift and updates the weights on the current episode, without checking this attribution against the planning loop itself. We follow the executed planning loop on pushing tasks. In most settings, with and without distribution shift, nearly all failures (at least 96%) are stalls, where the object stays in place while the model predicts progress. The warm-started gradient-descent (GD) planner then returns nearly the same plan, a fixed point where the agent mostly idles. We propose Unstick, which pairs on-policy fine-tuning before deployment with a fixed-weight loop breaker: a residual memory of the episode's prediction errors or random re-initialization at every replan. With GD, Unstick recovers most of the adaptation gain on pushing tasks with the memory, and with re-initialization most of it on shape shifts but much less on visual shifts. A large part of what limits these planners under GD is thus a fixed point of the planning loop, present with and without distribution shift, which a planner with fixed weights can break. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/unstick.
abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型通过模型预测控制从像素进行规划，但在其模型本应能处理的任务上却常常失败。测试时自适应将此类失败归因于分布偏移下的模型误差，并在当前回合更新权重，而未对照规划循环本身检查这一归因。我们在推动任务上跟踪执行中的规划循环。在大多数设置中，无论有无分布偏移，几乎所有失败（至少 96%）都是停滞，即物体保持原地不动，而模型却预测有进展。热启动的梯度下降（GD）规划器随后返回几乎相同的计划，这是一个智能体大多空转的不动点。我们提出 Unstick，它将部署前的同策略微调与固定权重的循环打破器相结合：回合预测误差的残差记忆，或在每次重新规划时随机重新初始化。在使用 GD 时，Unstick 通过记忆在推动任务上恢复了大部分自适应增益，通过重新初始化在形状偏移上恢复了大部分增益，但在视觉偏移上恢复得少得多。因此，在 GD 下限制这些规划器的很大一部分因素是规划循环的一个不动点，无论有无分布偏移都存在，而固定权重的规划器可以打破它。代码见 https://github.com/jhlee0619/unstick。
tldr_zh: JEPA规划器失败多因规划循环不动点导致停滞，Unstick可破解。
cover_zh: 规划器总在原地卡住？原来是不动点在作怪｜Unstick 来破局
